WITH state_counts AS (
    SELECT p.death_state, COUNT(DISTINCT h.player_id) AS player_count
    FROM hall_of_fame AS h
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = h.player_id
    GROUP BY p.death_state
), overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(player_count) AS overall_average
    FROM state_counts
)
SELECT AVG(sc.player_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(sc.player_count - o.overall_average) AS average_excess
FROM state_counts AS sc
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE sc.player_count > o.overall_average;
